title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on John 6: the five barley loaves, the walk on the sea, the bread of life, and the disciples who turned back.

questions.text: What did Philip answer when Jesus asked where to buy bread for the crowd?
questions.explanation: Philip answered that two hundred denarii worth of bread would not be sufficient for them, that every one of them might receive a little.

answers.text: The villages nearby had bread to sell
They should send the crowd away to eat
Two hundred denarii worth of bread would not be enough
The disciples had no money with them at all

questions.text: What did Andrew say the boy there had?
questions.explanation: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said there was a boy there who had five barley loaves and two fish, but asked what these were among so many.

answers.text: Five barley loaves and two fish
Seven loaves and a few small fish
Twelve loaves and no fish
Two barley loaves and five fish

questions.text: About how many men sat down on the grass?
questions.explanation: There was much grass in that place, and the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

answers.text: About four thousand
About five hundred
About twelve thousand
About five thousand

questions.text: How many baskets were filled with the broken pieces left over?
questions.explanation: They gathered up the broken pieces and filled twelve baskets from the five barley loaves, left over by those who had eaten.

answers.text: Seven
Twelve
Five
Two

questions.text: What did Jesus do when he perceived that they were about to make him king by force?
questions.explanation: Perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, he withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

answers.text: He got into the boat with his disciples
He asked them to choose another king
He withdrew again to the mountain by himself
He went down into Capernaum to teach

questions.text: What did the disciples see as they rowed across the sea in the dark?
questions.explanation: When they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat, and they were afraid, but he said, "It is I. Don't be afraid."

answers.text: A light burning on the shore at Capernaum
Jesus walking on the sea
Boats coming out from Tiberias
An angel standing on the water

questions.text: Who did Jesus say gives the true bread out of heaven?
questions.explanation: He said it was not Moses who gave them the bread out of heaven, but his Father who gives them the true bread out of heaven.

answers.text: His Father
Moses
The prophets who wrote about it
The Son of Man alone

questions.text: What did Jesus call himself when they asked him for this bread?
questions.explanation: He said, "I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty."

answers.text: The living water
The light of men
The friend of the bridegroom
The bread of life

questions.text: What did many of his disciples do after hearing what he said?
questions.explanation: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

answers.text: They asked him to explain the saying again
They went back and walked no more with him
They followed him into the synagogue
They went to tell the Jews in Jerusalem

questions.text: What did Simon Peter answer when Jesus asked the twelve if they also wanted to go away?
questions.explanation: Simon Peter answered, "Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life."

answers.text: "We will stay with you until the feast is over"
"Tell us plainly who you are, and we will stay"
"Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life"
"Let us go back to Galilee with you today"
